title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A classic Argentinian recipe featuring charred beef skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: Thread beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the skewers with the olive oil mixture, making sure each piece of beef is coated.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, warm the chimichurri sauce according to package instructions or by heating it in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the beef is cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and brush with the chimichurri sauce.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
